quest.title: Past Mementos
quest.description: You accompany Kaveh back to his place, where he digs out a number of mementos from his childhood. Are there any interesting stories behind these simple objects?

chapter.title: The Pendulum of Weal and Woe

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We can try asking some of her old acquaintances...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then maybe we should just put it aside for now.
